hypotheses.title: Call-Put Implied Volatility Sentiment Skew Subindustry Rank Divergence (Strike 2A)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates the 20-day Call-to-Put implied volatility spread scaled by mean IV ((implied_volatility_call_20 - implied_volatility_put_20) / implied_volatility_mean_20) smoothed over 8 days. Replacing fat-tailed group_zscore with group_rank strictly bounds portfolio weights uniformly across all equities in the subindustry, eliminating the 15.38% weight concentration spike while smoothing turnover to ~12% and pushing Fitness from 0.86 to >1.55 on the proven 1.76 Sharpe core signal.
confounders: Sudden single-stock earnings announcements causing temporary symmetric IV spikes
Options market illiquidity during extreme macro volatility regimes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high call-to-put IV skew is caused exclusively by downside protective call hedging rather than institutional bullish positioning.

hypotheses.title: Pure Call-Put IV Ratio with Hyperbolic Tangent Tail Bounding (Strike 2B)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Computes the exact dimensionless call-to-put IV ratio (implied_volatility_call_20 / implied_volatility_put_20 - 1) smoothed over a 10-day decay window. Applying tanh to the subindustry z-score strictly caps extreme tail exposures between -1.0 and +1.0, resolving weight concentration while filtering out unit incompatibility warnings and compressing turnover to ~11%.
confounders: Broad market retail speculative call buying creating transient noise in high-beta names
Severe skew distortion on deep out-of-the-money options
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during protracted market pullbacks where call buyers suffer consecutive theta decay losses.

hypotheses.title: Intra-Subindustry Clamped IV Spread and 5-Day Pullback Divergence (Strike 2C)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Preserves the linear responsiveness of the original 1.76 Sharpe signal ((implied_volatility_call_20 - implied_volatility_put_20) / implied_volatility_mean_20) but hard-clamps the intra-subindustry z-score at [-2.0, +2.0] to eliminate fat-tail weight concentration. Subtracting the smoothed 5-day return captures immediate mean-reversion entries on high-sentiment names.
confounders: Unprecedented micro-cap earnings volatility breaking standard deviation thresholds
Subindustry classification shifts affecting group standardization
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if short-term 5-day momentum continues runaway trend without mean-reverting toward subindustry peers.
